in_hebrew.name: Bauer
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bauer הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the German word 'bauern,' meaning 'farmer.' This name has been borne by various historical figures, including the 16th-century German painter Albrecht Dürer and the 19th-century German composer Richard Wagner.
